question: Which pre-t0 state factor causally changes the latency of an otherwise identical prefill execution?

allowed_changes: factor-controlled decode-pipeline preparation SAFE or Q4FAST
timing instrumentation around existing execute_prepared and q2_top2 boundaries
static SHA256 census for all common prefill SPIR-V artifacts

D_decode_pipeline_set.definition: Which decode pipeline set is prepared before the measured prefill. The prefill chain is identical in both levels.

C_conditioning.definition: Immediately before each measured prefill, execute either one exact prefill-only conditioning pass or one full 32-token inference using the selected decode pipeline set; then reset model execution buffers identically before measurement.

per_attempt_sequence: execute frozen conditioning according to arm; conditioning timing is not a primary outcome

endpoints.secondary_role: mechanism localization only; cannot override primary gate
semantic_guard: exact first-token equality across all four arms for matched workload/session/attempt

threshold.provenance: pre-existing ArcLLM/ANL64 materiality convention; frozen prospectively

admissible_inference.H_DPIPE_SUPPORTED: H_DPIPE >=1.10 independently in W-S and W-C in both sessions.
admissible_inference.H_PRECOND_SUPPORTED: H_PRECOND_Q4FAST >=1.10 while H_PRECOND_SAFE <1.10 independently in W-S and W-C in both sessions.
admissible_inference.H_STATE_INTERACTION_SUPPORTED: PARENT_LIKE >=1.10 and INTERACTION >=1.10 independently in W-S and W-C in both sessions.
admissible_inference.H_NULL_SUPPORTED: No H_DPIPE/H_PRECOND/H_STATE_INTERACTION support rule passes AND PARENT_LIKE <1.10 independently in W-S and W-C in both sessions after H-ART is falsified.
admissible_inference.UNRESOLVED_STABLE_HARM: PARENT_LIKE >=1.10 in W-S and W-C in both sessions but none of H_DPIPE/H_PRECOND/H_STATE_INTERACTION support rules pass.
admissible_inference.HISTORICAL_HARM_NOT_STABLY_REPRODUCED: PARENT_LIKE is mixed across required workload/session comparisons (neither all <1.10 nor all >=1.10) and no registered mechanism has a fully replicated support gate.

static_H_ART_gate.on_mismatch: STOP_TIMING_AND_CLASSIFY_H_ART_SUPPORTED_STATIC; open only a new artifact-normalization intervention specification, not factorial timing.

observability_boundary.reason: No command-lifecycle intervention exists in the 2x2 design. A component delta can localize time but cannot establish command-pool policy as cause.
